messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "should not breastfeed while using this medicine"
set: ["should not breastfeed while using this medicine", "it may not be safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "ask doctor if safe to breastfeed while using medicine", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine", "do not breastfeed while taking Amlodipine", "call your doctor if condition does not improve or gets worse while using this medicine", "do not breastfeed", "tell your doctor if your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking this medicine", "these symptoms may occur while you take this medicine", "you should not stop using carvedilol suddenly", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "talk with your doctor if you think your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "do not breastfeed during treatment", "stop taking this medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
